name: Mitani Corporation
summary: Mitani Corporation engages in the information systems, construction materials, energy, lifestyle-related business and development business in Japan and internationally. The company offers various software, including ERP, image-processing systems, and information infrastructure environments; sells, builds, and supports computer-related systems for academic institutions; and support investment and management of IT projects for academic institutions, including educational systems, portals, portfolios, and account management.
